messages:
maya (design): quick follow-up from the design review — the routing policies editor preview needs a couple small but important UX/accessibility fixes before the next demo. tagging @arne @dev
arne (pm): list them out pls, repro steps + copy recs if you have them
maya (design): repro: Policy > Rules > open Preview panel > enable simulated traffic > add 7 rules > narrow to 440px > reorder the top item > run sim. Problems: 1) screen reader says 'list updated' (no context), 2) the conflict badge is hover-only and hides on small widths, 3) after sim the summary toast isn't announced or keyboard reachable
ben (research): saw this in lab: users expected an explicit announcement for actions. generic counts confuse them. they also couldn't find why a rule was skipped because the badge only shows on hover.
dev (frontend): can repro in Chrome + NVDA. we currently remount the preview which nukes the aria-live region and focus. easy-ish fixes: keep a singleton live region outside the preview, and expose the badge as a focusable element (button) with aria-describedby for details
keisha (engineer): implementation plan: 1) sr-announcer singleton with `aria-live="assertive"` for per-action moves and `aria-live="polite"` for end-of-sim summary, 2) debounce rapid move events (200ms) to avoid spam but always emit final summary, 3) ensure toast has `role="status"` + tabindex=0 so keyboard users can reach it
maya (design): copy proposals: move => `Moved "{ruleTitle}" to position {n}`; conflict (short) => `Priority conflict — unreachable` (aria: `Priority conflict, rule unreachable`); summary => `Simulation complete — 12 matched, 3 fallback`
arne (pm): short copy looks good. question: should move messages include model names when routing changes? e.g., `Moved "A" to position 1, will route to model-x`
ben (research): mixed feedback on extra detail — it helps ops folks but verbose messages are noisy during bulk edits. suggest short by default, with a verbose mode in settings for power users
dev (frontend): we can add a small toggle inside the preview panel: "How this sounds" (short/verbose). it can render the last announcement text in plain text for copy review; TTS later. low risk and helpful for writers
keisha (engineer): also flag: drag handle currently gets tabbed after the title which is awkward for keyboard reordering. i'll make the handle first in tab order with `aria-label="Drag to reorder"` and add `role="button"` and `aria-grabbed` during drag
maya (design): layout nit: badge overlaps preview header at <560px. suggest making the badge inline with wrapping allowed and reduce min-width so it never pushes content under the header
a11y-bot: scan results: 1) color contrast: .rule-badge fails AA small text, ratio 2.7:1 (recommend switch to purple-80 / #fff or add outline), 2) live region remounted on preview updates, 3) drag-handle missing aria-label. fixes: bump contrast, keep live region mounted, add aria attributes to handle
arne (pm): i'll file tickets: INF-3901 sr-announcer + debounce + visible preview, INF-3902 badge keyboard + contrast + copy, INF-3903 drag-handle focus + aria. target: PRs by Thu, QA next Monday
maya (design): last ask — please include a tiny non-voice preview box behind the toggle so content writers can iterate copy without assistive tech. thanks team :pray:
keisha (engineer): ok i'll expose the srAnnouncer.lastMessage in the UI and make it toggleable. assigning tasks now
arne (pm): great. assign owners and schedule NVDA/VoiceOver testing. thanks everyone :rocket:
